label: 💥 Crack (0.1 beta)
description: A hybrid-rate drum voice: a record-ready modern snare at the home settings, then a whole percussion kit under the macros. Wires = head only / vintage / modern / snare+clap / clap only. Body = thump / analog / membrane / piccolo / metal. Snap = brush / stick / modern snap / hard / zap. Heat = raw / warm / smack / clipped / destroyed. PUNCH = rimshot, GATE sustains, velocity opens the crack.
